svg.title: Everyday choices can help forests
svg.desc: Top-down view of a plate on a wooden table: a beef steak slides away and is replaced in turn by tofu, a fish fillet and finally a roast chicken drumstick. The camera glides to a desk where a tall stack of paper shrinks in stages as sheets are reused and drop into a recycling tray, a sapling grows in a pot and a recycling symbol turns once. The camera pulls back to show both scenes, with the line: Using resources thoughtfully and choosing responsibly sourced products can help reduce pressure on forests. Simplified: The closing line is the quiz explanation itself (the shorter slogan in the brief would only repeat it).
